verdicts.claim: Game 7 was a 125-94 loss 'at Cleveland'
verdicts.note: Detroit was the No. 1 seed and hosted Game 7, so it was a home loss to Cleveland. The fanbase file already said home. Fixed. The MLK Day trip to Cleveland is a separate regular-season game.

verdicts.claim: Movement 2027 runs May 28-31
verdicts.note: Memorial Day 2027 is Monday, May 31, so the weekend is May 29-31. Still to verify, including whether Hart Plaza's renovation affects the site.

verdicts.claim: Practice facility named 'Henry Ford Detroit Pistons Performance Center'
verdicts.note: The official name, used elsewhere and in the strategy, is Henry Ford Health Pistons Performance Center. Fixed.

verdicts.claim: Carhartt is 'Dearborn-born'
verdicts.note: Carhartt was founded in Detroit (1889) and is headquartered in Dearborn. Fixed in hoops, culture and retail-behavior. The strategy still says "Dearborn-founded."

verdicts.claim: Cue named 'Bad Boys-era teal'
verdicts.note: Teal was the 1996-2001 era, after the Bad Boys. Renamed "1990s teal."

verdicts.claim: Jalen Rose 'runs' the Jalen Rose Leadership Academy
verdicts.note: Softened to "founded." Its current status is still to verify, since I'm not sure the school operates as described.

verdicts.claim: 'Detroit vs. Everybody' slogan came out of a 2016 posse cut
verdicts.note: The 2016 posse cut shares the phrase, but Tommey Walker's apparel brand carried the slogan earlier. Reworded in the insight and vocabulary.

verdicts.claim: Tee Grizzley and Sada Baby are routinely tied to Pistons fandom courtside
verdicts.note: Only Tee Grizzley's arena presence is well known. Sada Baby's ties are unverified, so the line is softened. The strategy's opening-night plan still names both as ambassadors.

verdicts.claim: Underground Resistance palette is black and signal red/white
verdicts.note: UR's red accent is poorly sourced, and art.json says black and hazard yellow. Cut to black-on-black with a single accent. The strategy's Machine Lane palette still uses Signal Red.

verdicts.claim: Polish Village Cafe is on Joseph Campau
verdicts.note: It is on Yemans Street in Hamtramck. Fixed.

verdicts.claim: Taqueria El Rey is a Vernor Highway Mexicantown staple
verdicts.note: Couldn't place or confirm it. Replaced with Mexicantown Bakery, a long-running panaderia whose status is still to verify.

verdicts.claim: Takashi Yagihashi as a Detroit chef-driven, community-rooted voice
verdicts.note: He is a Chicago-based chef whose only Detroit-area link is a past restaurant, so he doesn't fit the Black-led, community-rooted point. Replaced with Dave Mancini (Supino Pizzeria).

verdicts.claim: Checker Bar is in Foxtown close to the arena district
verdicts.note: It is a downtown bar, not at the arena. Neighborhood and why-line softened.

verdicts.claim: Ben Wallace 'teal-era legacy' as the 2004 touchstone
verdicts.note: Wallace is remembered for four Defensive Player of the Year awards and 2004. Reworded.

verdicts.claim: Detroit Auto Show 'typically fall or winter', month 9
verdicts.note: Recent shows returned to mid-January. Moved to month 1, with a verify note.

verdicts.claim: New Dodge Lounge is a current Hamtramck DIY venue
verdicts.note: Couldn't confirm it still operates. Replaced with Small's Bar. Planet Ant Theatre stays, flagged unverifiable.

verdicts.claim: Detroit vs. Everybody is a 'global' brand tied to Eminem and Royce
verdicts.note: Overstated. Now "nationally known, worn by Detroit artists."

verdicts.claim: Burn Rubber is a Detroit sneaker boutique
verdicts.note: Checked live: the original Burn Rubber is in Royal Oak. Its Detroit sister store, Two18, opened in Feb 2022 across from Eastern Market. A Profit Brand store was also reported for a former Burn Rubber space. The current status of both is unconfirmed.

verdicts.claim: 'Detroit Historical Society and the Fisher Building shops' in New Center
verdicts.note: The Historical Society is in Midtown, not New Center. The entry now covers only the Fisher Building shops (Pure Detroit).

verdicts.claim: Bad Boys look is 'black-and-teal-era'; 1990s palette is teal and purple
verdicts.note: The Bad Boys wore royal blue, red and white. The 1990s set was teal, red and black. Fixed.

verdicts.claim: Windsor fans cross by the 'new' Gordie Howe bridge
verdicts.note: Whether the bridge has opened as of fall 2026 is unconfirmed. Reworded to "once open to traffic."

verdicts.claim: Hockeytown Cafe is still open near the arenas
verdicts.note: Checked live: no closure reports, and a June 2026 review describes dining there before a Tigers game. It is at 2301 Woodward, near Comerica Park and Fox Theatre, so "near the arena" is loose. Using it for a strategy watch party is plausible.

verdicts.claim: Lafayette Coney Island is open and a reliable pre-game stop
verdicts.note: Checked live: it closed repeatedly over rats (2022, Jan 2025), and no 2026 status turned up. Don't build a launch around it without confirming. American Coney Island is the safer anchor.

verdicts.claim: Murals in the Market, Inner State Gallery and Sheefy McFly are active with the stated roles
verdicts.note: Long-running, but the 2026 edition, the gallery's status and McFly's Eastern Market tie need a live check.

verdicts.claim: Heidelberg Project and The Alley Project are operating and open to partners
verdicts.note: Heidelberg's structure has changed over the years. Confirm what remains on site and who grants permissions.

verdicts.claim: Baker's Keyboard Lounge, El Club and Third Man Records Detroit are all open
verdicts.note: All are established but small. Confirm each is operating in fall 2026.

verdicts.claim: Submerge / Underground Resistance HQ is in the 'Eastside industrial corridor' and its Exhibit museum is open
verdicts.note: The neighborhood label is loose and visiting hours are unknown. Confirm before any outreach.

verdicts.claim: Movement 2027 is at Hart Plaza
verdicts.note: Hart Plaza is in a multi-year renovation. Confirm the 2027 site and dates.

verdicts.claim: Nike Factory Store at Great Lakes Crossing
verdicts.note: Checked live 2026-10-10: the city of Auburn Hills reported the Nike Factory Store moving to a 14,000 sq ft space in District 9 of Great Lakes Crossing Outlets, and mall pages still list it. No 2026-dated status was found.

verdicts.claim: Shinola Midtown flagship and Pure Detroit stores are open
verdicts.note: Both brands have had ownership and footprint changes. Confirm locations before naming them as doors or partners.

verdicts.claim: Detroit vs. Everybody and Detroit Hustles Harder are operating with stores
verdicts.note: The strategy's top collab depends on this. Confirm the stores, ownership and any Nike or Pistons ties.

verdicts.claim: Past Pistons City Edition concepts were automotive / Motor City shorthand
verdicts.note: The dossier admitted it couldn't reconstruct past concepts, so the pattern claim became an open audit item.

verdicts.claim: Teal hex values (#00778B, #00A3AD, #00A19C, #00857C) across dossiers
verdicts.note: Four different teal hexes describe the same 1996-2001 color. Sample the official value before specifying any colorway.

verdicts.claim: Boston opening night tips at 3:00 p.m. ET Tuesday
verdicts.note: Checked live 2026-10-10: the Celtics' schedule release and other outlets list Tuesday Oct 20 at Detroit at 3 p.m. ET on NBC and Peacock. Hedges removed in strategy and rhythm.

verdicts.claim: Carhartt described as 'Dearborn-founded' (topInsights)
verdicts.note: Carhartt was founded in Detroit and is headquartered in Dearborn. The editor should change the wording.

verdicts.claim: Uniform 'avoid' list says recent Pistons City Editions leaned on chrome-and-engine concepts
verdicts.note: Unsupported. The uniform dossier says past concepts aren't reliably known. Rewrite as "audit past City Editions" or drop the claim.

verdicts.claim: Burn Rubber is a Detroit door for collabs, Glaze shoe and heritage release
verdicts.note: Burn Rubber is in Royal Oak. The Detroit store is its sister, Two18 (opened 2022), and the status of both is unconfirmed. The editor should name Two18 and add a confirm-open step.

verdicts.claim: Opening-night plan names Tee Grizzley and Sada Baby as team-linked ambassadors
verdicts.note: Only Tee Grizzley's Pistons tie is reasonably established. Rephrase as "Detroit artists, starting with Tee Grizzley, after vetting."

verdicts.claim: Pewabic glaze lines People Mover stations and Pewabic will partner
verdicts.note: Unconfirmed: the People Mover tile link, and whether Pewabic would license a product partnership. The whole Glaze uniform concept depends on both.

verdicts.claim: Machine Lane palette and thesis describe techno as 'black-and-signal-red'
verdicts.note: Signal red isn't a documented UR code, and art.json says black and hazard yellow. Confirm with the collective or drop the red claim.

summary: The dossiers hold up on the verified facts: 60-22, the No. 1 seed, the 125-94 Game 7 loss to Cleveland, Duren's $200M, the Oct 20 Boston opener, Cup Group A, MLK Day at Cleveland, no Christmas game and Specter. One real contradiction: rhythm put Game 7 at Cleveland, but the top seed hosted it. Most other errors were small local facts: Carhartt's founding city, Polish Village Cafe's street, Burn Rubber's location, the Bad Boys and teal-era palettes and the origin of "Detroit vs. Everybody." The brief needs edits, and its biggest unverified dependencies are the Pewabic partnership and the Great Lakes Crossing Nike store.
